what: Which code produced artifacts/cfd3d/vlm/fish3d-*/vlm.json, which keys were added by hand afterwards, and the re-runs that check both. Written after the fact; the output files are not rewritten.

first_committed.note: the fish outputs were committed here, with hand-added keys; vlm.py at b98f32b (blob 9eb3aee3) carries a partial lint edit and was NOT used to produce or re-run them

hand_added_note: status and convergence_sweep were written by hand at b98f32b (convergence_sweep from a separate 24/36/48 lattice sweep run by hand); no code in this repo produces them

verification_2026_10_31.method: re-ran vlm.py@cdcf1c41 'fish' on the same 8dc5cc4 inputs (capped: TasksMax 32, MemoryMax 3G, swap 0, single-threaded BLAS); compared the parsed JSON with the committed file after removing only the hand-added keys

refactor_check.scope: v3c only; v3a and v3b were not re-run with the refactored code. controls.json was regenerated byte-identical at 5ce6cca (earlier check)

verification_2026_10_31.negative_control: producer v3a re-run compared with committed v3c minus status: not equal (the comparison can fail)

consequence: the committed numbers are the producer's; the refactor is behaviour-neutral on the case checked. v3b stays NOT CONVERGED.
